title: Sail Away - Vacation Rental in Seacrest Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… "Sail Away,” your dream retreat in Seacrest Beach! This pet-friendly getaway features 5 spacious suites, a game room, and easy access to local shops, dining, and the beach. Cruise around on 7 included bikes or relax by two community pools. Enjoy added perks like an elevator, EV car charger, and thoughtful amenities for a stress-free stay. Perfect for making lifelong memories, “Sail Away” is ready to make your vacation unforgettable. Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Pet-Friendly Home – Bring your furry friends along and enjoy a warm, welcoming space where pets are part of the family.Zero-Entry Pool with Splash Pad & Grills – Enjoy family fun with splash pad fountains for the little ones, pool & spa for adults and gas grills with poolside dining, all just steps from your door!Game Room – Enjoy endless entertainment with ping pong, arcade games, TV, and game console connections for family-friendly fun!Located Steps From Boutique Shops, Dining & Live Music – Immerse yourself in the lively coastal atmosphere, with unique shops, delicious food, and live music just around the corner.Elevator, Onsite Parking for 2 cars and Electric Car Charger – Enjoy modern comforts and effortless convenience, perfect for stress-free living.7 Bikes Included – Explore the beauty of Seacrest Beach on two wheels, making every ride a breezy, scenic adventure.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "The property was exactly as described and super convenient to dining and shops. Loved the clean and spacious environment!" – Holly K.⭐ "Amazing family getaway! The kids adored the splash pad at the pool, and the game room made evenings unforgettable." – Carol C.⭐ "Perfect location and incredibly comfortable. A stress-free stay within walking distance to everything we needed!" – Traci M.*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into "Sail Away" and instantly feel at home in a space designed for style and comfort. The living room is bright, welcoming, and perfect for family gatherings, featuring plush seating and a Smart TV. Large windows and a balcony let the Florida sunshine pour in, creating an inviting atmosphere to relax.Bright and Airy Living Room with a BalconySmart TVs Throughout the Home for EntertainmentArcade and Ping Pong Table in the Game Room downstairs*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Cook up your favorite meals in a state-of-the-art kitchen with sleek appliances, expert design, and an open concept that keeps you connected to your family. The timeless decor and large dining table make it the perfect setting for cherished family moments.Full Chef’s Kitchen with Modern AppliancesDining Table for 8 with Elegant LightingBreakfast Bar Seating for 4 for Quick Snacks*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***"Sail Away" spares no attention to detail when it comes to comfort. With five bedrooms spread across three floors, every guest will have their own slice of luxury.1st FloorBunk Nook with 1 Queen-over-Queen Custom Bunk Bed and large smart TVPrimary Suite with 1 King Bed, smart TV and Primary Bathroom with tub/shower combo2nd FloorBunk Room with 1 Twin-over-Twin Custom Bunk Bed, smart TV and ensuite bathroom with walk-in shower3rd FloorPrimary Suite with 1 King Bed and Primary Bathroom featuring Soaking tub, dual vanities and walk-in showerKing Guest Bedroom (L) with 1 King BedKing Guest Bedroom (R) with 1 King BedShared Full Bathroom with dual vanities and tub/shower combo*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Nestled in the heart of Seacrest Beach, you’re just steps from everything you need for the perfect getaway. Wander to boutique shops, savor local flavor in fantastic restaurants, or bike to pristine sandy beaches nearby. The property also offers access to two nearby community pools, perfect for kids and adults alike. One features a zero-entry splash pad for the little ones, while live music, boutique shopping, and outdoor grilling are just steps away.Zero-Entry Pool with Splash Pad – Enjoy family-friendly, resort-style pools with a fun splash pad, adult pool and community hot tub for everyone's fun.Poolside Grilling Stations – Relax with outdoor dining at convenient poolside grills, perfect for any evening.Boutique Shops and Restaurants (1-Min Walk) – Explore charming shops and cozy eateries just steps away.Beach Access (3-Min Bike Ride) – Pedal to the pristine shoreline for a day by the ocean.Kid-Friendly Biking Throughout the Community – Kids can safely explore the community on their bikes.Live Music at Peddler’s Pavilion (Seasonal) – Enjoy live tunes and a vibrant atmosphere that brings everyone together.Neighboring Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach – Discover the beauty and charm of these iconic coastal towns.*** PET POLICY ***Pet-friendly with a non-refundable pet fee of $250 + tax.Pets are not allowed on furniture or beds.Dogs must be kept in a crate when left unattended by guests.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers.Pet-friendly with a non-refundable pet fee of $250 + tax.This property has 7 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 96178STRO #: STR-096178
